description: I'm an early-stage founder, filmmaker and national-level exhibitor at a government-recognised science expo. I'm building a platform that brings fragmented reports of public-infrastructure damage together so municipalities can identify and solve city problems. I enjoy Unreal Engine game development, web systems and visual storytelling, and use DaVinci Resolve. Join X Factor to build boldly. We're seeking teammates in coding, game design, 3D/animation, space science, UI/UX and data.
